create_SetArticulatedObjectTask_subclass: create a subclass of SetArticulatedObjectTask implementing _gen_start_state, _get_look_pos, and _get_spawn_region for a new articulated object
use_set_args_to_target_marker: use set_args to configure the target marker and object index for an articulated object task instance
sample_robot_start_position: call _sample_robot_start with a transform matrix to get the robot angle and starting position for a task episode
reset_articulated_object_task: call reset on a RearrangeOpenDrawerTaskV1 or RearrangeCloseFridgeTaskV1 instance to initialize the episode with proper joint states
configure_joint_motor_settings: use _set_link_state with a numpy array to set joint positions on the target articulated object during task reset
